lastText: The Case Is ClosedThe Tunnel OpenNew Ending Discovered · 1 / 29THIRTY THOUSAND NAPOLEONS: A CITY BANK ROBBEDIt is the largest robbery in the City for a decade, and the whole of it has been done with a spade and a jar of paraffin and four pounds a week. The gold, thirty thousand napoleons in boxes lent by the Bank of France, has gone out through the cellar of a pawnbroker in Saxe-Coburg Square, and down the Metropolitan, and on to the Continent. John Clay is not seen again. Jabez Wilson, who had been an innocent party to the whole of it, is eventually found, in a very modest lodging, in the Borough, with his hair, which is now going rather grey, in a small and rather sad ring. The League, you think, as you sit at the window and look at the street, was always better than the thing that it covered.The Empty Purse · 5 choices · Evidence +3, Standing -1, Nerve 0, Hours -1, Hands +1, Wires 0The Case-BookThe Red-Headed League (a minor case, 1890): 1 of 3 endings found.1 of 5 volumes finished.
